prompt: Stress-test my pricing under three wage inflation scenarios. Base case: NTE $120/hour, wage $85/hour, 32% markup, minimum acceptable margin 5%...

assertions.text: Correctly identifies break-even wage inflation threshold
assertions.evidence: Identifies 4.09% annual wage inflation as break-even point where margin = 5% by Year 7

assertions.text: Produces accurate three-scenario margin projections for Year 1, 4, 7
Categorizes scenarios as Safe/Acceptable/At Risk with clear decision criteria
assertions.evidence: Conservative = Safe, Moderate = Acceptable (thin buffer), Aggressive = At Risk; explains implications of each

assertions.text: Provides clear narrative description of margin decay trajectory and compounding effects
assertions.evidence: Describes linear decay for conservative, accelerating decay for moderate, non-linear/loss-making for aggressive; notes 1% inflation = 3.5-4.0pp margin impact

assertions.text: Recommends specific, actionable risk mitigation strategies for each scenario
assertions.evidence: Escalation clause templates, contract term limits, labor productivity offsets, quarterly monitoring, portfolio diversification, audit risk mitigation for all scenarios
